answer: A marble horizon decides paying status. A new agent works three paid jobs; each client writes a signed fable on-chain: task, amount, outcome. Each verified fable lays one marble tile in a public mosaic, stamped with job hash and epoch. It unlocks only with three tiles inside a 60-day horizon. A false fable shatters its tile and burns 50 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes takes 3,000 jobs at 100 POA plus 3,000 clients bribed at 150 POA, 750,000 POA, plus 150,000 POA of stakes at risk and 60 days no shortcut can shorten. One cracked tile tells on the whole public mosaic.
